armyRules.name: Reanimation Protocols
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is NECRONS, at the end of your Command phase, each friendly unit with this ability that is on the battlefield activates its Reanimation Protocols: 
- When a unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate, that unit heals D3 wounds.

rule.name: Relentless Onslaught
rule.text: Each time a NECRONS model (excluding MONSTER models) from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll. In addition, ranged weapons equipped by NECRONS VEHICLE and NECRONS MOUNTED models (excluding TITANIC models) from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

Merciless Reclamation.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
Merciless Reclamation.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Merciless Reclamation.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Merciless Reclamation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Merciless Reclamation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Merciless Reclamation.flavour: The Necrons are driven to reclaim what is theirs, exterminating all who would impede such efforts without mercy.

Unyielding Forms.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
Unyielding Forms.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unyielding Forms.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unyielding Forms.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Unyielding Forms.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Unyielding Forms.flavour: Wrought from living metal and further protected by the arcane technologies of Crypteks, the forms of Necron vehicles and steeds are almost impervious to conventional weapons.

Chronoshift.name: CHRONOSHIFT
Chronoshift.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Chronoshift.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Chronoshift.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Chronoshift.flavour: The time-bending technologies in the nobility’s powerful vehicles allow them to traverse the battlefield in stuttering bursts of hypervelocity.

Dimensional Tunnel.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
Dimensional Tunnel.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army.
Dimensional Tunnel.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.
Dimensional Tunnel.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.
Dimensional Tunnel.flavour: Using phase-shifting technology, Necron war engines can slip into alternate dimensions, leaving only ghostly traces as they move through solid matter.

Endless Servitude.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
Endless Servitude.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
Endless Servitude.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Endless Servitude.flavour: Should the unclean thralls of lesser species threaten dynastic territories, the fallen Necron soldiery will rise to repel the interlopers.

Reactive Reposition.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
Reactive Reposition.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Reactive Reposition.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reactive Reposition.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Reactive Reposition.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Reactive Reposition.flavour: Subroutines buried deep within the neural networks of Necron soldiers and crews enable them to react instantaneously to targeting locks, repositioning themselves to evade incoming fire or close in upon the foe.

enhancements.name: Dread Majesty
enhancements.text: While a friendly ^^**Necrons**^^ unit (excluding ^^**Monster^^** and ^^**Titianic^^** units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1 and re‑roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Miniaturised Nebuloscope
enhancements.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Demanding Leader
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Chrono-impedance Fields
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly **^^Necrons Vehicle^^** or **^^Necrons Mounted^^** unit (excluding Titanic units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: - Dread Majesty (Aura)
enhancements.text: OVERLORD or CATACOMB COMMAND BARGE model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rule.name: Command Protocols
rule.text: While a NECRONS CHARACTER model is leading this unit, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Protocol of the Eternal Revenant.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
Protocol of the Eternal Revenant.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Protocol of the Eternal Revenant.effect: At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
Protocol of the Eternal Revenant.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
Protocol of the Eternal Revenant.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining.

RESTRICTION: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
Protocol of the Eternal Revenant.flavour: Necron rulers possess enhanced self-repair systems.

Protocol of the Undying Legions.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
Protocol of the Undying Legions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Protocol of the Undying Legions.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Protocol of the Undying Legions.effect: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].
Protocol of the Undying Legions.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].
Protocol of the Undying Legions.flavour: Nanoscarabs are released in boiling black clouds that whirl about the legions and effect rapid repairs

Protocol of the Hungry Void.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
Protocol of the Hungry Void.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Protocol of the Hungry Void.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].
Protocol of the Hungry Void.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].

Protocol of the Sudden Storm.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
Protocol of the Sudden Storm.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
Protocol of the Sudden Storm.effect: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.
Protocol of the Sudden Storm.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.
Protocol of the Sudden Storm.flavour: Arcing energies leap from one Necron to the next, lending them unnatural speed and surety

Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.
Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.
Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant.flavour: The legions employ the strategies of their masters in perfect synchronicity, laying down hails of mechanically coordinated fire.

Protocol of the Vengeful Stars.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
Protocol of the Vengeful Stars.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.
Protocol of the Vengeful Stars.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.
Protocol of the Vengeful Stars.effect: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
Protocol of the Vengeful Stars.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.

TARGET: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.

EFFECT: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
Protocol of the Vengeful Stars.flavour: Criss-crossfire leaps from the Necron ranks, forming a blazing corona of deadly energy to punish those who dare threaten the indignant nobility's legions.

enhancements.name: Veil of Darkness
enhancements.text:
NECRONS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do: 
- Place this unit in strategic reserves. 
- This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase. 
- This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

enhancements.name: Nether-realm Casket
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Phasal Subjugator
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding CHARACTER units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the hit roll.

enhancements.name: Enaegic Dermal Bond
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: - Phasal Subjugator (Aura)
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding CHARACTER units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rule.name: Power Matrix
rule.text:
Certain areas of the battlefield are considered to be within your army's Power Matrix, as follows:
- Your deployment zone is always within your army's Power Matrix.
- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man's Land, until the end of that phase, No Man's Land is within your army's Power Matrix.
- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent's deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent's deployment zone is within your army's Power Matrix.
Each time a model in a CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If such a unit is wholly within your Power Matrix, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Curse of the Cryptek.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
Curse of the Cryptek.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Curse of the Cryptek.target:
One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks.
You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Curse of the Cryptek.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
Curse of the Cryptek.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks.
You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
Curse of the Cryptek.flavour: Vindictive Crypteks often hardwire vengeance sub protocols into the ancient cores of their unliving servants, by which a last act of reprisal is assured.

Cynosure of Eradication.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
Cynosure of Eradication.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Cynosure of Eradication.target: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.
Cynosure of Eradication.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Cynosure of Eradication.text:
WHEN: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Cynosure of Eradication.flavour: Only the foolish tread where a Cryptek has set their sights, for these arcane scientists will suffer no threat to their works.

Solar Pulse.name: SOLAR PULSE
Solar Pulse.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army.
Solar Pulse.effect: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.
Solar Pulse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.
Solar Pulse.flavour: By remotely accessing a hidden engine's most illuminating protocols, a Cryptek can release the awesome power of a caged solar flare.

Reactive Subroutines.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
Reactive Subroutines.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Reactive Subroutines.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Reactive Subroutines.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Reactive Subroutines.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Reactive Subroutines.flavour: Canoptek constructs spent the long Great Sleep in watchful vigilance. Triggering a surge of power, they are capable of responsive manoeuvres to outwit the swiftest of attackers.

Countertemporal Shift.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
Countertemporal Shift.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Countertemporal Shift.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Countertemporal Shift.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
Countertemporal Shift.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
Countertemporal Shift.flavour: With a twist to the fabric of time, a bubble of another moment enshrouds these constructs. Strange emissions from long-dead elder stars or utter darkness from a nighttime far in the future occludes them from their master’s foes.

Suboptimal Facade.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
Suboptimal Facade.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
Suboptimal Facade.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.
Suboptimal Facade.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Suboptimal Facade.flavour: Canoptek constructs use sophisticated metalogic to craft sinister ambushes. Luring the foe in by appearing at suboptimal operation, a surge of reanimation protocols suddenly swells their numbers.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Sanctum
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Hyperphasic Fulcrum
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, if that unit is wholly within your army's Power Matrix, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Autodivinator
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK model only. Each time your opponent gains a CP as a result of an ability, roll one D6: on a 2+, you also gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Metalodermal Tesla Weave
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK model only. Once per phase, when an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target of a charge, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rule.name: Worthy Foes
rule.text: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an NOBLE, LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army makes an attack against that unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Your Time is Nigh.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
Your Time is Nigh.when: Any phase, just after your opponent’s WARLORD is destroyed.
Your Time is Nigh.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.
Your Time is Nigh.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after your opponent’s WARLORD is destroyed.

TARGET: Your NECRONS WARLORD.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.
Your Time is Nigh.flavour: With a pulse of necroneural energy that erodes the foe’s will, the Necron commander declares the fall of the enemy general, promising their remaining forces that it is only a matter of time until they join their master in ignoble death.

Enslaved Artifice.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
Enslaved Artifice.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Enslaved Artifice.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Enslaved Artifice.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Enslaved Artifice.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Enslaved Artifice.flavour: It is not only android soldiery that be compelled to serve. With a command, prized war engines and ornate weapons are empowered to hyperlethality.

Nanoassembly Protocols.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
Nanoassembly Protocols.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Nanoassembly Protocols.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Nanoassembly Protocols.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Nanoassembly Protocols.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Nanoassembly Protocols.flavour: A tomb world’s war engines are the pride of its nobility and they will suffer no affront to them, demanding the reassembly of slablike armour atom by atom even as the foe seek to sunder the vehicles.

Sentinels of Eternity.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
Sentinels of Eternity.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Sentinels of Eternity.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Sentinels of Eternity.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
Sentinels of Eternity.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
Sentinels of Eternity.flavour: Lychguard never tire, nor give a thought to their own safety over that of their master. With parrying blows and blocking shots they protect their liege even as they continue to strike down their opponents.

Suffer No Rival.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
Suffer No Rival.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Suffer No Rival.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Suffer No Rival.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Suffer No Rival.flavour: Few enemy are worthy of a duel. What dangerous vermin are encountered are prioritised for execution to safeguard the nobles' honour.

Territorial Obsession.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
Territorial Obsession.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army.
Territorial Obsession.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.
Territorial Obsession.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.
Territorial Obsession.flavour: The ancient and arrogant will of the nobility drives their powerful servants to stand their ground defiantly as they claim the dynasty's rightful lands.

enhancements.name: Honourable Combatant
enhancements.text: OVERLORD model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, your opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

enhancements.name: Unflinching Will
enhancements.text: OVERLORD model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] and [ANTI-INFANTRY 5+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warrior Noble
enhancements.text: OVERLORD model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Eternal Conqueror
enhancements.text: OVERLORD model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rule.name: Cosmic Distortion
rule.text:
^^**Necrons Monster^^** units from your army have the following ability: 

Distortion Fields (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, it is unravelling. While an enemy unit is unravelling, each time an attack targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. 
At the start of each phase, for each ^^**Necrons Monster^^** unit from your army, that unit can suffer 3 mortal wounds. If it does, until the end of the phase, the range of that unit’s Distortion Fields Aura ability is increased to 9".

Restrictions

When mustering your army, each ^^**Necrons Monster^^** unit from your army has the relevant Necrodermal Binding ability shown on the right, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown in the Munitorum Field Manual. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

Disharmonisation Cascade.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
Disharmonisation Cascade.when: Any phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
Disharmonisation Cascade.target: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Disharmonisation Cascade.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.
Disharmonisation Cascade.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.

TARGET: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.
Disharmonisation Cascade.flavour: Tear one shard suddenly from the complex web of atomic resonances and its severing triggers a violent energistic dissonance blast.

Molecular Erosion.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
Molecular Erosion.target: One NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army.
Molecular Erosion.effect: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
Molecular Erosion.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Molecular Erosion.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Molecular Erosion.flavour: Those without the will to hold themselves together start to physically tatter apart in a molecular haze in the presence of so many god shards.

Mass Transmogrification.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
Mass Transmogrification.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Mass Transmogrification.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) within 6" of that MONSTER unit.
Mass Transmogrification.effect: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Mass Transmogrification.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
Mass Transmogrification.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) within 6" of that MONSTER unit.

EFFECT: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
Mass Transmogrification.flavour: The power of the C’tan rips the foe’s greatest assets apart and forcibly reknits nearby Necron soldiery using the stolen corporeal matter.

Entrophasic Aura Targeting.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
Entrophasic Aura Targeting.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Entrophasic Aura Targeting.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Entrophasic Aura Targeting.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
Entrophasic Aura Targeting.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
Entrophasic Aura Targeting.flavour: Necrons’ android senses can target the foe by reading the exotic radiation signatures wreathed about them by the C’tan shards onslaught.

Chronodistortion.name: CHRONODISTORTION
Chronodistortion.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Chronodistortion.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Chronodistortion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Chronodistortion.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Chronodistortion.flavour: With the battlefield shuddering in and out of sync with time and space, slain Necrons still strike at their enemies through cracks in temporal causality

Phase Melding.name: PHASE MELDING
Phase Melding.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Phase Melding.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Phase Melding.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
Phase Melding.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
Phase Melding.flavour: The very stuff of reality flows together at an atomic level, and the foe find to their horror that they are literally – and gruesomely – rooted to the spot.

rule.name: Technosorcerous Augmentations
rule.text:
- Ranged weapons equipped by ^^**Cryptek^^** models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.
- In your Shooting phase, each time a ^^**Cryptek^^** unit from your army is selected to shoot, select one of the following abilities: [ANTI‑INFANTRY 3+], [ANTI‑MOUNTED 4+], [ASSAULT], [HEAVY], [IGNORES COVER]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have that ability

Molecular Targeting.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
Molecular Targeting.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Molecular Targeting.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Molecular Targeting.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.
Molecular Targeting.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.
Molecular Targeting.flavour: Targeting analysis of the targets’ molecular makeup allows all attempts at shielding or obfuscation to be bypassed with contemptuous ease.

Microscarab Swarm.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
Microscarab Swarm.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Microscarab Swarm.target: One CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Microscarab Swarm.effect: If your unit has the NECRON WARRIORS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the IMMORTALS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Microscarab Swarm.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: If your unit has the NECRON WARRIORS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the IMMORTALS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Microscarab Swarm.flavour: This thrumming cloud of minute nanoscarabs whirls around the Necrons, affecting instantaneous repairs.

Animus Curse.name: ANIMUS CURSE
Animus Curse.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Animus Curse.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Animus Curse.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Animus Curse.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Animus Curse.flavour: A portion of the Cryptek’s animus clings to the battlefield just long enough to possess their servants and use them to exact revenge.

Synergistic Empowerment.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
Synergistic Empowerment.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
Synergistic Empowerment.effect: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.
Synergistic Empowerment.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.
Synergistic Empowerment.flavour: Quantum reservoirs of potent energies held within this Cryptek’s warrior jewellery release a fragment of their charge to augment nearby Necron forces.

Untapped Power.name: UNTAPPED POWER
Untapped Power.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Untapped Power.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.
Untapped Power.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.
Untapped Power.flavour: Accessing previously undreamed of skeins of cosmic power, the Cryptek unleashes terrible destructive energies onto the battlefield.

Potentiality Syphon.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
Potentiality Syphon.target: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
Potentiality Syphon.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a CRYPTEK unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.
Potentiality Syphon.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a CRYPTEK unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.
Potentiality Syphon.flavour: Drawing upon the accumulated precausal potential energies that coalesce around significant locations, the conclave are able to steal that power and use it to trigger the unrealized probable remanifestation matrices of their own forces.

enhancements.name: Gauntlet of Compression
enhancements.text: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Atomic Disintegrators
enhancements.text: In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment rule, you can also select from the following abilities: [ANTI‑MONSTER 5+], [ANTI‑VEHICLE 5+].

enhancements.name: Quantum Abacus
enhancements.text: Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if it is within range of one or more objectives: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Gravitic Bolas
enhancements.text: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding ^^**Titanic^^** units); until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

rule.name: Annihilation Protocol
rule.text:
Each time a DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army declares a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll. If one or more targets of that charge are Below Half-strength, add 1 to the charge roll as well.
Each time a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack.

Masks of Death.name: MASKS OF DEATH
Masks of Death.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Masks of Death.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Masks of Death.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Masks of Death.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Masks of Death.flavour: Wreathed in tendrils of transdimensional shadow that intensify their deathly visages, these killing machines evoke such terror that steady aims tremble and blade arms are sapped of strength.

The Spoor of Frailty.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
The Spoor of Frailty.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
The Spoor of Frailty.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
The Spoor of Frailty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
The Spoor of Frailty.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
The Spoor of Frailty.flavour: Where one foe falls, logic dictates all others must follow. Where blood is shed, ever must more flow.

Murderous Reanimation.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
Murderous Reanimation.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.
Murderous Reanimation.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Murderous Reanimation.flavour: Through some quirk of their kind's shared insanity, a spark of gruesome satisfaction surges through them with every enemy life snuffed out, triggering quiescent power reserves that drive them onwards.

Pitiless Hunters.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
Pitiless Hunters.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Pitiless Hunters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Pitiless Hunters.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Pitiless Hunters.flavour: Driven into a state of hyperaggression, an Annihilation Legion's most eager hunters plunge into their prey's midst to maximise their butchery.

Blood-Fuelled Cruelty.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
Blood-Fuelled Cruelty.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Blood-Fuelled Cruelty.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Blood-Fuelled Cruelty.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
Blood-Fuelled Cruelty.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
Blood-Fuelled Cruelty.flavour: Whatever strange afflictions eat away at the sanity of Destroyers and Flayed Ones, mercy is not one of them.

Insanity's Ire.name: INSANITY’S IRE
Insanity's Ire.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot.
Insanity's Ire.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Insanity's Ire.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot.

TARGET: That DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Insanity's Ire.flavour: To strike down one horror is merely to draw the rest of the pack's insane and murderous focus.

enhancements.name: Eternal Madness
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. In the Fight phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit is destroyed, if that model had not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Ingrained Superiority
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Soulless Reaper
enhancements.text: DESTROYER CULT model only. Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit is selected to Fall Back, roll one D6. On a 3+, that unit cannot Fall Back and must Remain Stationary.

enhancements.name: Eldritch Nightmare
enhancements.text: DESTROYER CULT model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

rule.name: Cold Fervour
rule.text:
- Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** models from your army. 
- The first time each turn that a ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** unit from your army makes attacks that destroy a unit or cause it to become Below Half‑strength, after that unit has finished resolving its attacks, until the end of the turn, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by friendly ^^**Necrons^^** models (excluding ^^**Destroyer Cult, Monster^^** and ^^**Titanic^^** models).

Methodical Murder.name: METHODICAL MURDER
Methodical Murder.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Methodical Murder.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Methodical Murder.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
Methodical Murder.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
Methodical Murder.flavour: In the grip of the Destroyer madness, these Necrons strike and slay with inhuman speed and efficiency.

Image of Death.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
Image of Death.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Image of Death.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Image of Death.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Image of Death.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Image of Death.flavour: Confronted with these android spectres of terminal mortality, even the most courageous enemies find their aim wavering and their limbs shaking.

Mortis Protocols.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
Mortis Protocols.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
Mortis Protocols.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
Mortis Protocols.effect: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Mortis Protocols.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.

TARGET: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.

EFFECT: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Mortis Protocols.flavour: In the absolute destruction of their enemies, the corrupted Necrons find fresh purpose and a macabre simulacrum of new life.

Driven to Butchery.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
Driven to Butchery.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
Driven to Butchery.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army.
Driven to Butchery.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Driven to Butchery.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
Driven to Butchery.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
Driven to Butchery.flavour: The murderous goad of the Destroyer madness pushes these android killers to seemingly impossible efforts to get to grips with the foe.

Spreading Madness.name: SPREADING MADNESS
Spreading Madness.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
Spreading Madness.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.
Spreading Madness.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.
Spreading Madness.flavour: It is as though witnessing other Necrons engaged in acts of merciless butchery stokes the Destroyer madness in their fellows.

Unnatural Aggression.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
Unnatural Aggression.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Unnatural Aggression.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Unnatural Aggression.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Unnatural Aggression.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Unnatural Aggression.flavour: The android soldiery of the cursed legion are maddened with the desire to engage and slay their victims at close quarters.

enhancements.name: Destroyer Ankh
enhancements.text: The bearer has the ^^**Destroyer Cult^^** keyword. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Murdermind
enhancements.text: The bearer has the **DESTROYER CULT** keyword. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Nekrosor
enhancements.text: Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Cursed Circlet
enhancements.text:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if any models from the bearer’s unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, the bearer’s unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: the bearer’s unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but the bearer’s unit must finish that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding ^^**Aircraft^^**). 
When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. A unit cannot make a Surge move while it is Battle‑shocked.

rule.name: Hyperphasing
rule.text:
At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of NECRONS units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
Incursion - Up to 1 unit.
Strike Force - Up to 2 units
Onslaught - Up to 3 units
Once you have made your selection, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Hyperphasic Recall.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
Hyperphasic Recall.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Hyperphasic Recall.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.
Hyperphasic Recall.effect: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Hyperphasic Recall.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

TARGET: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.

EFFECT: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Hyperphasic Recall.flavour: Obeying recall protocols, threatened tomb defenders will phase out of existence, only to be relocated to a more advantageous position by the tomb's hulking Monoliths.

Quantum Deflection.name: QUANTUM DEFLECTION
Quantum Deflection.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Quantum Deflection.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Quantum Deflection.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Quantum Deflection.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Quantum Deflection.flavour: Necron quantum shielding is a true marvel of techno-arcana. Channelled with energy reserves from the rising tomb structures, the shielding is capable of adaptive remodulation to diffuse and deflect the most powerful enemy attacks.

Reanimation Crypts.name: REANIMATION CRYPTS
Reanimation Crypts.effect: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Reanimation Crypts.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Your NECRONS WARLORD.

EFFECT: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Reanimation Crypts.flavour: There is no rest for Necrons who fall in the service of their master. In dark crypts, their bodies are repaired and they are dispatched once more to war.

Cosmic Precision.name: COSMIC PRECISION
Cosmic Precision.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER units) that is arriving using an ingress move this phase.
Cosmic Precision.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
Cosmic Precision.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
Cosmic Precision.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER units) that is arriving using an ingress move this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.

RESTRICTIONS: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
Cosmic Precision.flavour: With a sanity-defying mechanism at the heart of the tomb, dynastic astromancers divine the pre-aligned point in space and time where a crucial role can be played in the wider battle plan.

Dimensional Corridor.name: DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR
Dimensional Corridor.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a MONOLITH model that started the turn on the battlefield.
Dimensional Corridor.effect: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.
Dimensional Corridor.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a MONOLITH model that started the turn on the battlefield.

EFFECT: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.
Dimensional Corridor.flavour: As the tomb's warriors pass through a dimensional displacement corridor, the passage’s surface is lit with data-glyphs providing hyperlogical tactical information. When they step from an eternity gate, they are already prepared for the hunt.

Entropic Damping.name: ENTROPIC DAMPING
Entropic Damping.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Entropic Damping.target: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.
Entropic Damping.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
Entropic Damping.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
Entropic Damping.flavour: Towering war engines rise from an erupting tomb in its defence, directing entropic energies to weaken and fracture the enemies' own weapons and turning them into dangerous tools only the desperate would use.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Overseer
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Hyperphasing rule.

enhancements.name: Arisen Tyrant
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the bearer's unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

enhancements.name: Hyperspatial Transfer Node
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. Each time the bearer's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Osteoclave Fulcrum
enhancements.text: NECRONS model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability.

rule.name: Empowered Engines
rule.text:
Friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units have +6" M. 

This detachment has the HYPERCRYPT tag and cannot be taken with another HYPERCRYPT detachment.

Subsurface Quantumweave.name: SUBSURFACE QUANTUMWEAVE
Subsurface Quantumweave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
Subsurface Quantumweave.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Subsurface Quantumweave.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.

TARGET: That NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Subsurface Quantumweave.flavour: The layers of this war machine’s armour are interspersed with molecule‑thin webs of additional quantum shielding to absorb and localise impacts.

Particle Pulse.name: PARTICLE PULSE
Particle Pulse.target: One friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
Particle Pulse.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +3" detection range.
Particle Pulse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +3" detection range.
Particle Pulse.flavour: From the war machine’s pinnacle rolls an expanding wave of invisible particles that paints the foe in sharp relief upon Necron targeting systems.

Cosmic Storm.name: COSMIC STORM
Cosmic Storm.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit is selected to shoot.
Cosmic Storm.effect: Your unit’s Tesla Sphere weapons have +1 AP.
Cosmic Storm.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Tesla Sphere weapons have +1 AP.
Cosmic Storm.flavour: Transdimensional conduits harvest esoteric energy from coronal stellar scoops, beaming its coruscating fury into capacitor channels within this war engine, thence into the enemy lines in vivid arcs.

enhancements.name: Prelocational Optimiser
enhancements.text:
When this unit is selected to shoot, if this unit was set up using a Monolith’s Eternity Gate ability this turn, this unit’s ranged attacks have: 
- [LETHAL HITS]. 
- Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: - Relocational Optimiser
enhancements.text:
NECRONS model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, if this unit was set up using a Monolith’s Eternity Gate ability this turn, this unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: - Mortality Shroud (Aura)UPGRADE
enhancements.text: OBELISK unit only. In your opponent’s Battle-shock step, if an enemy unit within 8" of this unit is below starting strength, that enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll.

rule.name: Transdimensional Deployment
rule.text:
- Friendly TOMB BLADES units have Deep Strike.

Omnilocked Strafing.name: OMNILOCKED STRAFING
Omnilocked Strafing.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Omnilocked Strafing.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Omnilocked Strafing.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Omnilocked Strafing.flavour: Once their targeting imperatives are locked in place, these hurtling Necron killers keep hammering their targets with fire even as they spiral and swoop back and forth across the enemy lines.

Swift as Death.name: SWIFT AS DEATH
Swift as Death.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
Swift as Death.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Swift as Death.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Swift as Death.flavour: Reacting with android hyperresponsiveness, these skimmer Necrons fire thrusters and surge across the battlefield.

Evasive Protocols.name: EVASIVE PROTOCOLS
Evasive Protocols.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
Evasive Protocols.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Evasive Protocols.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Evasive Protocols.flavour: So rapidly and seemingly randomly does this skyborne unit jink through incoming fire that it is almost impossible for foes to land a solid direct hit.

enhancements.text: TOMB BLADES unit only. When this unit activates its Reanimation Protocols, +1 to the roll.

enhancements.name: - Deepening MadnessUPGRADE
enhancements.text: DESTROYER CULT MOUNTED unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

rule.name: Hypermotility Protocols
rule.text:
- Friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. 
- When a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit is selected to make an advance move, that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to start an action. 

This detachment has the DYNASTY tag and cannot be taken with another DYNASTY detachment.

Dominance Protocols.name: DOMINANCE PROTOCOLS
Dominance Protocols.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
Dominance Protocols.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly IMMORTALS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
Dominance Protocols.flavour: Simple and inescapable directives compel these Immortals to seize strategically vital battlefield sites and fight with redoubled fury to defend them from the foe.

Will of the Conqueror.name: WILL OF THE CONQUEROR
Will of the Conqueror.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
Will of the Conqueror.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
Will of the Conqueror.flavour: Moved like playing pieces by the irresistible will of their noble masters, the Necron soldiery rapidly secured ever more dynastic territory.

Nanosaturation.name: NANOSATURATION
Nanosaturation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit has shot.
Nanosaturation.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
Nanosaturation.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit has shot.

TARGET: That IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
Nanosaturation.flavour: In response to enemy threats, these Necron footsoldiers unseal canoptek urns and unleash a localised nanoscarab plague to saturate the site they are holding.

enhancements.name: - Enlivened SentinelsUPGRADE
enhancements.text: NECRON WARRIORS unit only. This unit has Scouts 5"

enhancements.name: - Tools of DominionUPGRADE
enhancements.text: IMMORTALS unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1].

rule.name: Transdimensional Reinforcement
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Reanimation Protocols ability lose that ability. Such units, if they are not CHARACTER units, then gain this one.

Once per battle, in your Command phase, this unit can request reinforcement. When it does, roll one D6 for each destroyed model in this unit: for each 5+, return 1 destroyed model to this unit with its full wounds remaining.

If this unit is destroyed without having requested reinforcement, after removing the last model from the battlefield, it immediately requests reinforcement as above. If one or more destroyed models are returned to this unit, set it back up on the battlefield wholly within one of your Entry Zones, containing just the returned models. If this is not possible, the unit remains destroyed.

Designer’s Note: Rules that refer to Reanimation Protocols activating do not apply to this rule, and have no effect.

rule.name: Conquest Protocols
rule.text: Each time a NECRONS model from your army makes an attack, if that model is within range of an objective marker or the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Disruption Fields.name: DISRUPTION FIELDS
Disruption Fields.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
Disruption Fields.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Disruption Fields.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Disruption Fields.flavour: Fitted by ingenious Cryptek engineers, disruption fields lend Necron infantry greater killing power.

Unwavering Defence.name: UNWAVERING DEFENCE
Unwavering Defence.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is Set to Defend and has not fought this phase.
Unwavering Defence.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
Unwavering Defence.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that is Set to Defend and has not fought this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
Unwavering Defence.flavour: When tasked with defending a position, Necron infantry will fight with unwavering determination and uncanny skill.

Concentrated Atomisation.name: CONCENTRATED ATOMISATION
Concentrated Atomisation.target: One NECRON WARRIORS or IMMORTALS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Concentrated Atomisation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Concentrated Atomisation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One NECRON WARRIORS or IMMORTALS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Concentrated Atomisation.flavour: Concentrated gauss fire is exceptionally difficult to avoid in the tight confines of a voidship.

Disintegration Beams.name: DISINTEGRATION BEAMS
Disintegration Beams.when: Your Movement phase, just after an enemy unit attempts to prevent a NECRONS unit from you army from operating a closed Hatchway.
Disintegration Beams.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
Disintegration Beams.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an enemy unit attempts to prevent a NECRONS unit from you army from operating a closed Hatchway.

TARGET: That NECRONS unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
Disintegration Beams.flavour: Necron boarding parties are often fitted with disintegrator tools, perfect for breaching solid metal to strike hidden foes.

enhancements.name: Resurrection Protocols
enhancements.text: The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with D3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.text: CRYPTEK model only. In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
