rule.name: Terrifying Charge
rule.text: Each time a NECRONS unit from your army declares a charge, each enemy unit that is a target of that charge must take a Leadership test: if failed, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Bathed in Blood.name: BATHED IN BLOOD
Bathed in Blood.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army
Bathed in Blood.effect: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
Bathed in Blood.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army

TARGET: That DESTROYER CULT unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
Bathed in Blood.flavour: The Destroyer Cults leave only blood, yore and butchered bodies to mark the decks they have taken.

Shadow Stalkers.name: SHADOW STALKERS
Shadow Stalkers.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
Shadow Stalkers.target: One FLAYED ONES unit from your army that is in Reserves.
Shadow Stalkers.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Shadow Stalkers.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Shadow Stalkers.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One FLAYED ONES unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Shadow Stalkers.flavour: Flayed Ones stalk the shadowy perimeters of the battlefield, descending upon the unwary to spill blood and harvest trophies from their corpses.

Rush to Slaughter.name: RUSH TO SLAUGHTER
Rush to Slaughter.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Rush to Slaughter.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit has the FLAYED ONES keyword, each time it moves, models in that unit can move through friendly DESTROYER CULT models as if they were not there. If your unit has the DESTROYER CULT keyword, models in it can move through friendly FLAYED ONES models as if they were not there.
Rush to Slaughter.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit has the FLAYED ONES keyword, each time it moves, models in that unit can move through friendly DESTROYER CULT models as if they were not there. If your unit has the DESTROYER CULT keyword, models in it can move through friendly FLAYED ONES models as if they were not there.
Rush to Slaughter.flavour: Often drawn to the same blood-soaked environs, Flayed Ones and Destroyers weave around one another in their desire to kill.

Terrifying Ambush.name: TERRIFYING AMBUSH
Terrifying Ambush.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Terrifying Ambush.effect: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
Terrifying Ambush.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That DESTROYER CULT unit.

EFFECT: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
Terrifying Ambush.flavour: The sudden appearance through a bulkhead or a hatchway of a blood-slick Necron Destroyer is enough to cause the boldest warrior to quiver.

enhancements.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. Once the bearer has destroyed one or more enemy units, it has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

rule.name: Retribution Protocols
rule.text: Each time an enemy unit destroys a CRYPTEK model from your army, until the end of the battle, each time a NECRONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Targeting Algorithms.name: TARGETING ALGORITHMS
Targeting Algorithms.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Targeting Algorithms.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Targeting Algorithms.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Targeting Algorithms.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Targeting Algorithms.flavour: A Cryptek's enhanced oculars possess exceptional visual acuity. Even in pitch-dark corridors, there can be no hiding from a Cryptek's wrath.

Quantum Flare-Shield.name: QUANTUM FLARE-SHIELD
Quantum Flare-Shield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Quantum Flare-Shield.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Quantum Flare-Shield.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 4+ invulnerable save.
Quantum Flare-Shield.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 4+ invulnerable save.
Quantum Flare-Shield.flavour: Crypteks enhance their living metal forms with all manner of reactive defences, including single-use quantum shields that flare into life to deflect incoming fire.

Phase-Shift.name: PHASE-SHIFT
Phase-Shift.target: One CANOPTEK WRAITHS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Phase-Shift.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
Phase-Shift.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Phase-Shift.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK WRAITHS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Phase-Shift.flavour: A Canoptek Wraith's dimensional destabilisation matrix allows it to phase through solid matter to breach sealed hatches and even solid walls.

Nanoscarab Virus.name: NANOSCARAB VIRUS
Nanoscarab Virus.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
Nanoscarab Virus.effect: For each open Hatchway within 3" of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.
Nanoscarab Virus.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Nanoscarab Virus.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: For each open Hatchway within 3" of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
Nanoscarab Virus.flavour: The Necrons possess swarms of minute nanoscarabs that burrow into power networks and wrest control of cogitator systems.

rule.name: Transdimensional Reinforcement
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Reanimation Protocols ability lose that ability. Such units, if they are not CHARACTER units, then gain this one.

Once per battle, in your Command phase, this unit can request reinforcement. When it does, roll one D6 for each destroyed model in this unit: for each 5+, return 1 destroyed model to this unit with its full wounds remaining.

If this unit is destroyed without having requested reinforcement, after removing the last model from the battlefield, it immediately requests reinforcement as above. If one or more destroyed models are returned to this unit, set it back up on the battlefield wholly within one of your Entry Zones, containing just the returned models. If this is not possible, the unit remains destroyed.

Designer’s Note: Rules that refer to Reanimation Protocols activating do not apply to this rule, and have no effect.

rule.name: Arcanoscientific Expertise
rule.text:
In your Command phase, for each CRYPTEK unit in your army, select one of the following abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability.

- Hyperlocation Stutter (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this model, add 2 to Advance rolls made for that unit.

- Transharmonic Disruption (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

- Quantum Interface (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Dynamic Reconfiguration.name: DYNAMIC RECONFIGURATION
Dynamic Reconfiguration.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
Dynamic Reconfiguration.effect: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.
Dynamic Reconfiguration.text:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.
Dynamic Reconfiguration.flavour: When a Cryptek's foes threaten to thwart their schemes, rapid reassessment of the situation ensures the most effective technoarcana is employed.

Hologyric Simulation.name: HOLOGYRIC SIMULATION
Hologyric Simulation.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Hologyric Simulation.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Hologyric Simulation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if your unit is within 6" of a friendly CRYPTEK unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Hologyric Simulation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if your unit is within 6" of a friendly CRYPTEK unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Hologyric Simulation.flavour: By creating a bubble of cycling holographic simulations, a Cryptek can analyse thousands of minutely varying outcomes in a moment, ensuring they or their servants can exploit their foes' weaknesses.

Anti-Proximal Subroutines.name: ANTI-PROXIMAL SUBROUTINES
Anti-Proximal Subroutines.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Anti-Proximal Subroutines.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
Anti-Proximal Subroutines.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
Anti-Proximal Subroutines.flavour: To counter the close-quarters threats in the depths of enemy vessels, Necrons employ firing patterns to scour enemy positions regardless of their proximity.

Continuum Realignment.name: CONTINUUM REALIGNMENT
Continuum Realignment.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
Continuum Realignment.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Continuum Realignment.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Continuum Realignment.flavour: Crypteks use strange technologies beyond the ken of other species, and are capable of altering space-time itself to ensure they are exactly where they need to be.

enhancements.name: Cryptometric Experimentation
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Toughness and Wounds characteristics of the bearer. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Portal Transmuter
enhancements.text: Once per turn, when the bearer ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 3" of an open Hatchway or when the bearer opens a Hatchway, it can, before any units decide if they wish to fire Overwatch, use this ability. If it does, remove the bearer from the battlefield and set it back up on the battlefield wholly within 3" of another open Hatchway and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. When doing so, if the bearer cannot be set back up on the battlefield, it is destroyed.

protocoloftheeternalrevenant.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
protocoloftheeternalrevenant.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
protocoloftheeternalrevenant.effect: At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
protocoloftheeternalrevenant.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
protocoloftheeternalrevenant.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining.

RESTRICTION: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
protocoloftheeternalrevenant.flavour: Necron rulers possess enhanced self-repair systems.

protocoloftheundyinglegions.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
protocoloftheundyinglegions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
protocoloftheundyinglegions.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
protocoloftheundyinglegions.effect: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].
protocoloftheundyinglegions.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].
protocoloftheundyinglegions.flavour: Nanoscarabs are released in boiling black clouds that whirl about the legions and effect rapid repairs

protocolofthehungryvoid.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
protocolofthehungryvoid.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
protocolofthehungryvoid.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].
protocolofthehungryvoid.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].

protocolofthesuddenstorm.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
protocolofthesuddenstorm.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
protocolofthesuddenstorm.effect: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.
protocolofthesuddenstorm.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.
protocolofthesuddenstorm.flavour: Arcing energies leap from one Necron to the next, lending them unnatural speed and surety

protocoloftheconqueringtyrant.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
protocoloftheconqueringtyrant.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
protocoloftheconqueringtyrant.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.
protocoloftheconqueringtyrant.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.
protocoloftheconqueringtyrant.flavour: The legions employ the strategies of their masters in perfect synchronicity, laying down hails of mechanically coordinated fire.

protocolofthevengefulstars.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
protocolofthevengefulstars.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.
protocolofthevengefulstars.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.
protocolofthevengefulstars.effect: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
protocolofthevengefulstars.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.

TARGET: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.

EFFECT: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
protocolofthevengefulstars.flavour: Criss-crossfire leaps from the Necron ranks, forming a blazing corona of deadly energy to punish those who dare threaten the indignant nobility's legions.

masksofdeath.name: MASKS OF DEATH
masksofdeath.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
masksofdeath.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
masksofdeath.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
masksofdeath.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
masksofdeath.flavour: Wreathed in tendrils of transdimensional shadow that intensify their deathly visages, these killing machines evoke such terror that steady aims tremble and blade arms are sapped of strength.

thespooroffrailty.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
thespooroffrailty.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
thespooroffrailty.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
thespooroffrailty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
thespooroffrailty.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
thespooroffrailty.flavour: Where one foe falls, logic dictates all others must follow. Where blood is shed, ever must more flow.

murderousreanimation.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
murderousreanimation.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.
murderousreanimation.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
murderousreanimation.flavour: Through some quirk of their kind's shared insanity, a spark of gruesome satisfaction surges through them with every enemy life snuffed out, triggering quiescent power reserves that drive them onwards.

pitilesshunters.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
pitilesshunters.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
pitilesshunters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
pitilesshunters.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
pitilesshunters.flavour: Driven into a state of hyperaggression, an Annihilation Legion's most eager hunters plunge into their prey's midst to maximise their butchery.

bloodfuelledcruelty.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
bloodfuelledcruelty.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
bloodfuelledcruelty.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
bloodfuelledcruelty.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
bloodfuelledcruelty.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
bloodfuelledcruelty.flavour: Whatever strange afflictions eat away at the sanity of Destroyers and Flayed Ones, mercy is not one of them.

insanitysire.name: INSANITY’S IRE
insanitysire.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot.
insanitysire.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
insanitysire.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot.

TARGET: That DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
insanitysire.flavour: To strike down one horror is merely to draw the rest of the pack's insane and murderous focus.

curseofthecryptek.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
curseofthecryptek.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
curseofthecryptek.target:
One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks.
You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
curseofthecryptek.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
curseofthecryptek.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks.
You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
curseofthecryptek.flavour: Vindictive Crypteks often hardwire vengeance sub protocols into the ancient cores of their unliving servants, by which a last act of reprisal is assured.

cynosureoferadication.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
cynosureoferadication.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
cynosureoferadication.target: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.
cynosureoferadication.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
cynosureoferadication.text:
WHEN: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
cynosureoferadication.flavour: Only the foolish tread where a Cryptek has set their sights, for these arcane scientists will suffer no threat to their works.

solarpulse.name: SOLAR PULSE
solarpulse.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army.
solarpulse.effect: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.
solarpulse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.
solarpulse.flavour: By remotely accessing a hidden engine's most illuminating protocols, a Cryptek can release the awesome power of a caged solar flare.

reactivesubroutines.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
reactivesubroutines.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
reactivesubroutines.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
reactivesubroutines.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
reactivesubroutines.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
reactivesubroutines.flavour: Canoptek constructs spent the long Great Sleep in watchful vigilance. Triggering a surge of power, they are capable of responsive manoeuvres to outwit the swiftest of attackers.

countertemporalshift.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
countertemporalshift.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
countertemporalshift.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
countertemporalshift.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
countertemporalshift.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
countertemporalshift.flavour: With a twist to the fabric of time, a bubble of another moment enshrouds these constructs. Strange emissions from long-dead elder stars or utter darkness from a nighttime far in the future occludes them from their master’s foes.

suboptimalfacade.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
suboptimalfacade.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
suboptimalfacade.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.
suboptimalfacade.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
suboptimalfacade.flavour: Canoptek constructs use sophisticated metalogic to craft sinister ambushes. Luring the foe in by appearing at suboptimal operation, a surge of reanimation protocols suddenly swells their numbers.

yourtimeisnigh.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
yourtimeisnigh.when: Any phase, just after your opponent’s WARLORD is destroyed.
yourtimeisnigh.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.
yourtimeisnigh.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after your opponent’s WARLORD is destroyed.

TARGET: Your NECRONS WARLORD.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.
yourtimeisnigh.flavour: With a pulse of necroneural energy that erodes the foe’s will, the Necron commander declares the fall of the enemy general, promising their remaining forces that it is only a matter of time until they join their master in ignoble death.

enslavedartifice.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
enslavedartifice.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
enslavedartifice.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
enslavedartifice.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
enslavedartifice.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
enslavedartifice.flavour: It is not only android soldiery that be compelled to serve. With a command, prized war engines and ornate weapons are empowered to hyperlethality.

nanoassemblyprotocols.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
nanoassemblyprotocols.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
nanoassemblyprotocols.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
nanoassemblyprotocols.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
nanoassemblyprotocols.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
nanoassemblyprotocols.flavour: A tomb world’s war engines are the pride of its nobility and they will suffer no affront to them, demanding the reassembly of slablike armour atom by atom even as the foe seek to sunder the vehicles.

sentinelsofeternity.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
sentinelsofeternity.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
sentinelsofeternity.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
sentinelsofeternity.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
sentinelsofeternity.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
sentinelsofeternity.flavour: Lychguard never tire, nor give a thought to their own safety over that of their master. With parrying blows and blocking shots they protect their liege even as they continue to strike down their opponents.

suffernorival.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
suffernorival.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
suffernorival.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
suffernorival.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
suffernorival.flavour: Few enemy are worthy of a duel. What dangerous vermin are encountered are prioritised for execution to safeguard the nobles' honour.

territorialobsession.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
territorialobsession.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army.
territorialobsession.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.
territorialobsession.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.
territorialobsession.flavour: The ancient and arrogant will of the nobility drives their powerful servants to stand their ground defiantly as they claim the dynasty's rightful lands.

hyperphasicrecall.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
hyperphasicrecall.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
hyperphasicrecall.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.
hyperphasicrecall.effect: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
hyperphasicrecall.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

TARGET: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.

EFFECT: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
hyperphasicrecall.flavour: Obeying recall protocols, threatened tomb defenders will phase out of existence, only to be relocated to a more advantageous position by the tomb's hulking Monoliths.

quantumdeflection.name: QUANTUM DEFLECTION
quantumdeflection.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
quantumdeflection.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
quantumdeflection.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
quantumdeflection.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
quantumdeflection.flavour: Necron quantum shielding is a true marvel of techno-arcana. Channelled with energy reserves from the rising tomb structures, the shielding is capable of adaptive remodulation to diffuse and deflect the most powerful enemy attacks.

reanimationcrypts.name: REANIMATION CRYPTS
reanimationcrypts.effect: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
reanimationcrypts.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Your NECRONS WARLORD.

EFFECT: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
reanimationcrypts.flavour: There is no rest for Necrons who fall in the service of their master. In dark crypts, their bodies are repaired and they are dispatched once more to war.

cosmicprecision.name: COSMIC PRECISION
cosmicprecision.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER units) that is arriving using an ingress move this phase.
cosmicprecision.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
cosmicprecision.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
cosmicprecision.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.

cosmicprecision.flavour: With a sanity-defying mechanism at the heart of the tomb, dynastic astromancers divine the pre-aligned point in space and time where a crucial role can be played in the wider battle plan.

dimensionalcorridor.name: DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR
dimensionalcorridor.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a MONOLITH model that started the turn on the battlefield.
dimensionalcorridor.effect: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.
dimensionalcorridor.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a MONOLITH model that started the turn on the battlefield.

EFFECT: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.
dimensionalcorridor.flavour: As the tomb's warriors pass through a dimensional displacement corridor, the passage’s surface is lit with data-glyphs providing hyperlogical tactical information. When they step from an eternity gate, they are already prepared for the hunt.

entropicdamping.name: ENTROPIC DAMPING
entropicdamping.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
entropicdamping.target: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.
entropicdamping.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
entropicdamping.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
entropicdamping.flavour: Towering war engines rise from an erupting tomb in its defence, directing entropic energies to weaken and fracture the enemies' own weapons and turning them into dangerous tools only the desperate would use.

mercilessreclamation.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
mercilessreclamation.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
mercilessreclamation.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
mercilessreclamation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.
mercilessreclamation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.
mercilessreclamation.flavour: The Necrons are driven to reclaim what is theirs, exterminating all who would impede such efforts without mercy.

unyieldingforms.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
unyieldingforms.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unyieldingforms.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
unyieldingforms.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
unyieldingforms.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
unyieldingforms.flavour: Wrought from living metal and further protected by the arcane technologies of Crypteks, the forms of Necron vehicles and steeds are almost impervious to conventional weapons.

chronoshift.name: CHRONOSHIFT
chronoshift.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
chronoshift.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
chronoshift.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
chronoshift.flavour: The time-bending technologies in the nobility’s powerful vehicles allow them to traverse the battlefield in stuttering bursts of hypervelocity.

dimensionaltunnel.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
dimensionaltunnel.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army.
dimensionaltunnel.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.
dimensionaltunnel.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC units) from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.
dimensionaltunnel.flavour: Using phase-shifting technology, Necron war engines can slip into alternate dimensions, leaving only ghostly traces as they move through solid matter.

endlessservitude.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
endlessservitude.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
endlessservitude.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
endlessservitude.flavour: Should the unclean thralls of lesser species threaten dynastic territories, the fallen Necron soldiery will rise to repel the interlopers.

reactivereposition.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
reactivereposition.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
reactivereposition.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
reactivereposition.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
reactivereposition.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
reactivereposition.flavour: Subroutines buried deep within the neural networks of Necron soldiers and crews enable them to react instantaneously to targeting locks, repositioning themselves to evade incoming fire or close in upon the foe.

moleculartargeting.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
moleculartargeting.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
moleculartargeting.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
moleculartargeting.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.
moleculartargeting.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.
moleculartargeting.flavour: Targeting analysis of the targets’ molecular makeup allows all attempts at shielding or obfuscation to be bypassed with contemptuous ease.

microscarabswarm.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
microscarabswarm.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
microscarabswarm.target: One CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
microscarabswarm.effect: If your unit has the NECRON WARRIORS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the IMMORTALS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
microscarabswarm.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: If your unit has the NECRON WARRIORS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the IMMORTALS keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
microscarabswarm.flavour: This thrumming cloud of minute nanoscarabs whirls around the Necrons, affecting instantaneous repairs.

animuscurse.name: ANIMUS CURSE
animuscurse.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
animuscurse.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
animuscurse.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
animuscurse.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
animuscurse.flavour: A portion of the Cryptek’s animus clings to the battlefield just long enough to possess their servants and use them to exact revenge.

synergisticempowerment.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
synergisticempowerment.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
synergisticempowerment.effect: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.
synergisticempowerment.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.
synergisticempowerment.flavour: Quantum reservoirs of potent energies held within this Cryptek’s warrior jewellery release a fragment of their charge to augment nearby Necron forces.

untappedpower.name: UNTAPPED POWER
untappedpower.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
untappedpower.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.
untappedpower.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.
untappedpower.flavour: Accessing previously undreamed of skeins of cosmic power, the Cryptek unleashes terrible destructive energies onto the battlefield.

potentialitysyphon.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
potentialitysyphon.target: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
potentialitysyphon.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a CRYPTEK unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.
potentialitysyphon.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a CRYPTEK unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.
potentialitysyphon.flavour: Drawing upon the accumulated precausal potential energies that coalesce around significant locations, the conclave are able to steal that power and use it to trigger the unrealized probable remanifestation matrices of their own forces.

methodicalmurder.name: METHODICAL MURDER
methodicalmurder.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
methodicalmurder.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
methodicalmurder.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
methodicalmurder.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
methodicalmurder.flavour: In the grip of the Destroyer madness, these Necrons strike and slay with inhuman speed and efficiency.

imageofdeath.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
imageofdeath.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
imageofdeath.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
imageofdeath.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
imageofdeath.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
imageofdeath.flavour: Confronted with these android spectres of terminal mortality, even the most courageous enemies find their aim wavering and their limbs shaking.

mortisprotocols.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
mortisprotocols.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
mortisprotocols.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
mortisprotocols.effect: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
mortisprotocols.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.

TARGET: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.

EFFECT: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
mortisprotocols.flavour: In the absolute destruction of their enemies, the corrupted Necrons find fresh purpose and a macabre simulacrum of new life.

driventobutchery.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
driventobutchery.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
driventobutchery.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army.
driventobutchery.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
driventobutchery.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
driventobutchery.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
driventobutchery.flavour: The murderous goad of the Destroyer madness pushes these android killers to seemingly impossible efforts to get to grips with the foe.

spreadingmadness.name: SPREADING MADNESS
spreadingmadness.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
spreadingmadness.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.
spreadingmadness.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.
spreadingmadness.flavour: It is as though witnessing other Necrons engaged in acts of merciless butchery stokes the Destroyer madness in their fellows.

unnaturalaggression.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
unnaturalaggression.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
unnaturalaggression.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
unnaturalaggression.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
unnaturalaggression.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
unnaturalaggression.flavour: The android soldiery of the cursed legion are maddened with the desire to engage and slay their victims at close quarters.

disharmonisationcascade.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
disharmonisationcascade.when: Any phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
disharmonisationcascade.target: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
disharmonisationcascade.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.
disharmonisationcascade.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.

TARGET: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.
disharmonisationcascade.flavour: Tear one shard suddenly from the complex web of atomic resonances and its severing triggers a violent energistic dissonance blast.

molecularerosion.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
molecularerosion.target: One NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army.
molecularerosion.effect: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
molecularerosion.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
molecularerosion.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
molecularerosion.flavour: Those without the will to hold themselves together start to physically tatter apart in a molecular haze in the presence of so many god shards.

masstransmogrification.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
masstransmogrification.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
masstransmogrification.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) within 6" of that MONSTER unit.
masstransmogrification.effect: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
masstransmogrification.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
masstransmogrification.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) within 6" of that MONSTER unit.

EFFECT: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
masstransmogrification.flavour: The power of the C’tan rips the foe’s greatest assets apart and forcibly reknits nearby Necron soldiery using the stolen corporeal matter.

entrophasicauratargeting.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
entrophasicauratargeting.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
entrophasicauratargeting.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
entrophasicauratargeting.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
entrophasicauratargeting.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTERS) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
entrophasicauratargeting.flavour: Necrons’ android senses can target the foe by reading the exotic radiation signatures wreathed about them by the C’tan shards onslaught.

chronodistortion.name: CHRONODISTORTION
chronodistortion.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
chronodistortion.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
chronodistortion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
chronodistortion.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
chronodistortion.flavour: With the battlefield shuddering in and out of sync with time and space, slain Necrons still strike at their enemies through cracks in temporal causality

phasemelding.name: PHASE MELDING
phasemelding.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
phasemelding.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
phasemelding.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
phasemelding.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
phasemelding.flavour: The very stuff of reality flows together at an atomic level, and the foe find to their horror that they are literally – and gruesomely – rooted to the spot.

dominanceprotocols.name: DOMINANCE PROTOCOLS
dominanceprotocols.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
dominanceprotocols.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly IMMORTALS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
dominanceprotocols.flavour: Simple and inescapable directives compel these Immortals to seize strategically vital battlefield sites and fight with redoubled fury to defend them from the foe.

willoftheconqueror.name: WILL OF THE CONQUEROR
willoftheconqueror.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
willoftheconqueror.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
willoftheconqueror.flavour: Moved like playing pieces by the irresistible will of their noble masters, the Necron soldiery rapidly secured ever more dynastic territory.

nanosaturation.name: NANOSATURATION
nanosaturation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit has shot.
nanosaturation.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
nanosaturation.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit has shot.

TARGET: That IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
nanosaturation.flavour: In response to enemy threats, these Necron footsoldiers unseal canoptek urns and unleash a localised nanoscarab plague to saturate the site they are holding.

omnilockedstrafing.name: OMNILOCKED STRAFING
omnilockedstrafing.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
omnilockedstrafing.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
omnilockedstrafing.text:

TARGET: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
omnilockedstrafing.flavour: Once their targeting imperatives are locked in place, these hurtling Necron killers keep hammering their targets with fire even as they spiral and swoop back and forth across the enemy lines.

swiftasdeath.name: SWIFT AS DEATH
swiftasdeath.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
swiftasdeath.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
swiftasdeath.text:

TARGET: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
swiftasdeath.flavour: Reacting with android hyperresponsiveness, these skimmer Necrons fire thrusters and surge across the battlefield.

evasiveprotocols.name: EVASIVE PROTOCOLS
evasiveprotocols.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit.
evasiveprotocols.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
evasiveprotocols.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That NECRONS MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
evasiveprotocols.flavour: So rapidly and seemingly randomly does this skyborne unit jink through incoming fire that it is almost impossible for foes to land a solid direct hit.

subsurfacequantumweave.name: SUBSURFACE QUANTUMWEAVE
subsurfacequantumweave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
subsurfacequantumweave.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
subsurfacequantumweave.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.

TARGET: That NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
subsurfacequantumweave.flavour: The layers of this war machine’s armour are interspersed with molecule‑thin webs of additional quantum shielding to absorb and localise impacts.

particlepulse.name: PARTICLE PULSE
particlepulse.target: One friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.
particlepulse.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +3" detection range.
particlepulse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +3" detection range.
particlepulse.flavour: From the war machine’s pinnacle rolls an expanding wave of invisible particles that paints the foe in sharp relief upon Necron targeting systems.

cosmicstorm.name: COSMIC STORM
cosmicstorm.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit is selected to shoot.
cosmicstorm.effect: Your unit’s Tesla Sphere weapons have +1 AP.
cosmicstorm.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Tesla Sphere weapons have +1 AP.
cosmicstorm.flavour: Transdimensional conduits harvest esoteric energy from coronal stellar scoops, beaming its coruscating fury into capacitor channels within this war engine, thence into the enemy lines in vivid arcs.

disruptionfields.name: DISRUPTION FIELDS
disruptionfields.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
disruptionfields.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
disruptionfields.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
disruptionfields.flavour: Fitted by ingenious Cryptek engineers, disruption fields lend Necron infantry greater killing power.

unwaveringdefence.name: UNWAVERING DEFENCE
unwaveringdefence.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is Set to Defend and has not fought this phase.
unwaveringdefence.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
unwaveringdefence.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that is Set to Defend and has not fought this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
unwaveringdefence.flavour: When tasked with defending a position, Necron infantry will fight with unwavering determination and uncanny skill.

concentratedatomisation.name: CONCENTRATED ATOMISATION
concentratedatomisation.target: One NECRON WARRIORS or IMMORTALS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
concentratedatomisation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
concentratedatomisation.text:

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
concentratedatomisation.flavour: Concentrated gauss fire is exceptionally difficult to avoid in the tight confines of a voidship.

disintegrationbeams.name: DISINTEGRATION BEAMS
disintegrationbeams.when: Your Movement phase, just after an enemy unit attempts to prevent a NECRONS unit from you army from operating a closed Hatchway.
disintegrationbeams.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
disintegrationbeams.text:
