TARGET: That NECRONS unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
disintegrationbeams.flavour: Necron boarding parties are often fitted with disintegrator tools, perfect for breaching solid metal to strike hidden foes.

bathedinblood.name: BATHED IN BLOOD
bathedinblood.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army
bathedinblood.effect: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
bathedinblood.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army

TARGET: That DESTROYER CULT unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
bathedinblood.flavour: The Destroyer Cults leave only blood, yore and butchered bodies to mark the decks they have taken.

shadowstalkers.name: SHADOW STALKERS
shadowstalkers.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
shadowstalkers.target: One FLAYED ONES unit from your army that is in Reserves.
shadowstalkers.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
shadowstalkers.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
shadowstalkers.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One FLAYED ONES unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
shadowstalkers.flavour: Flayed Ones stalk the shadowy perimeters of the battlefield, descending upon the unwary to spill blood and harvest trophies from their corpses.

rushtoslaughter.name: RUSH TO SLAUGHTER
rushtoslaughter.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
rushtoslaughter.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit has the FLAYED ONES keyword, each time it moves, models in that unit can move through friendly DESTROYER CULT models as if they were not there. If your unit has the DESTROYER CULT keyword, models in it can move through friendly FLAYED ONES models as if they were not there.
rushtoslaughter.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit has the FLAYED ONES keyword, each time it moves, models in that unit can move through friendly DESTROYER CULT models as if they were not there. If your unit has the DESTROYER CULT keyword, models in it can move through friendly FLAYED ONES models as if they were not there.
rushtoslaughter.flavour: Often drawn to the same blood-soaked environs, Flayed Ones and Destroyers weave around one another in their desire to kill.

terrifyingambush.name: TERRIFYING AMBUSH
terrifyingambush.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
terrifyingambush.effect: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
terrifyingambush.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That DESTROYER CULT unit.

EFFECT: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
terrifyingambush.flavour: The sudden appearance through a bulkhead or a hatchway of a blood-slick Necron Destroyer is enough to cause the boldest warrior to quiver.

targetingalgorithms.name: TARGETING ALGORITHMS
targetingalgorithms.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
targetingalgorithms.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
targetingalgorithms.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
targetingalgorithms.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
targetingalgorithms.flavour: A Cryptek's enhanced oculars possess exceptional visual acuity. Even in pitch-dark corridors, there can be no hiding from a Cryptek's wrath.

quantumflareshield.name: QUANTUM FLARE-SHIELD
quantumflareshield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
quantumflareshield.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
quantumflareshield.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 4+ invulnerable save.
quantumflareshield.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 4+ invulnerable save.
quantumflareshield.flavour: Crypteks enhance their living metal forms with all manner of reactive defences, including single-use quantum shields that flare into life to deflect incoming fire.

phaseshift.name: PHASE-SHIFT
phaseshift.target: One CANOPTEK WRAITHS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
phaseshift.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
phaseshift.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
phaseshift.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One CANOPTEK WRAITHS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
phaseshift.flavour: A Canoptek Wraith's dimensional destabilisation matrix allows it to phase through solid matter to breach sealed hatches and even solid walls.

nanoscarabvirus.name: NANOSCARAB VIRUS
nanoscarabvirus.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
nanoscarabvirus.effect: For each open Hatchway within 3" of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.
nanoscarabvirus.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.
nanoscarabvirus.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: For each open Hatchway within 3" of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
nanoscarabvirus.flavour: The Necrons possess swarms of minute nanoscarabs that burrow into power networks and wrest control of cogitator systems.

dynamicreconfiguration.name: DYNAMIC RECONFIGURATION
dynamicreconfiguration.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
dynamicreconfiguration.effect: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.
dynamicreconfiguration.text:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.
dynamicreconfiguration.flavour: When a Cryptek's foes threaten to thwart their schemes, rapid reassessment of the situation ensures the most effective technoarcana is employed.

hologyricsimulation.name: HOLOGYRIC SIMULATION
hologyricsimulation.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
hologyricsimulation.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
hologyricsimulation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if your unit is within 6" of a friendly CRYPTEK unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
hologyricsimulation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if your unit is within 6" of a friendly CRYPTEK unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
hologyricsimulation.flavour: By creating a bubble of cycling holographic simulations, a Cryptek can analyse thousands of minutely varying outcomes in a moment, ensuring they or their servants can exploit their foes' weaknesses.

antiproximalsubroutines.name: ANTI-PROXIMAL SUBROUTINES
antiproximalsubroutines.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
antiproximalsubroutines.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
antiproximalsubroutines.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
antiproximalsubroutines.flavour: To counter the close-quarters threats in the depths of enemy vessels, Necrons employ firing patterns to scour enemy positions regardless of their proximity.

continuumrealignment.name: CONTINUUM REALIGNMENT
continuumrealignment.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
continuumrealignment.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
continuumrealignment.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
continuumrealignment.flavour: Crypteks use strange technologies beyond the ken of other species, and are capable of altering space-time itself to ensure they are exactly where they need to be.
